name: getObjectSchema
description: Returns Salesforce schema information. Omit all object arguments for the compact object index. For one object, use object-name; legacy singular aliases objects and sobject-name are also accepted.

name: soqlQuery
description: Executes a bounded read-only SOQL SELECT query. Use query; legacy q is also accepted. Include a top-level WHERE or LIMIT, unless the SELECT is aggregate-only. If truncated is true or done is not true, the result is incomplete: never claim all, none missing, an exact total, or reconciliation completeness. Task/Event objects and polymorphic activity relationships may be unavailable. If an activity read fails, explicitly say activity data could not be verified; never infer that no activity or tasks exist.

name: find
description: Executes a bounded SOSL FIND search across Salesforce objects. Use search; legacy q is also accepted. If truncated is true, the result is incomplete and must not support completeness or exact-total claims.

name: getUserInfo
description: Returns the authenticated Salesforce user identity and locale context.

name: listRecentSobjectRecords
description: Returns recently viewed records for one Salesforce object type.

name: getRelatedRecords
description: Returns bounded child records for a Salesforce parent record relationship. If truncated is true or done is not true, the result is incomplete and must not support completeness or exact-total claims.
